name: Harbin Z-20
armament: Door guns (12.7 mm) on some; Z-20T/armed variant with stub wings and ATGMs/rocket pods
protection: Game: airframe immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm damage rotor, engines and cockpit glass (forced landing on accumulated hits); launchers and MANPADS (off-list) destroy it.
visual_notes: Black Hawk-class utility helicopter: long cabin, five-blade main rotor (vs four on UH-60)
Flat-sided cabin with large sliding doors, tail-wheel landing gear
Canted tail rotor, horizontal stabiliser; armed variant has stub wings
